name: 75-challenge-tracker
description: A custom desktop app to track habits, weight, and journaling for a 75-day challenge. Built with Electron, Next.js, Node.js & SQLite. Features include daily tracking, reminders, streaks, journaling, and data export. Designed for personal growth and learning full-stack desktop app dev.

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS=true electron ./electron/main.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron" "npm run dev:backend"
